question: The Indian Mutiny of 1857 effectively ended in the city of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gwalior**__.

__
 
• **The Indian Mutiny of 1857 effectively ended in the city of Gwalior**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian Mutiny of 1857** was a major revolt in India in 1857–58 against the rule of the British East India Company, which acted as a sovereign power on behalf of the British Crown.

 
 
• The rebellion began on **10 May 1857** as a mutiny by soldiers of the Company's army in the garrison town of Meerut.
 
• **The rebellion posed a great threat to British power in that region and was only contained with the defeat of the rebels at Gwalior on 20 June 1858**__.
 
• Its name has been contested and has been described as the **Sepoy Mutiny, the Indian Rebellion, the Great Rebellion, the Rebellion of 1857, the Indian Rebellion, and the First War of Independence**.
